admission.justification: Recurring historical probes multiply remote work with task history, while calling absent finals pending would falsely promise self-healing; exact transition eligibility and honest terminal state prevent both.

applicability: Periodic dashboard landing observation sweeps for exact contract/code/memory/worktree keys.
conditions: A key observed active in the preceding sweep and then completed receives exactly one finishing attempt only if no valid persisted final matches its exact key/current contract.
Success may freeze fully observed facts; missing/corrupt/stale final or failed finishing attempt remains honest missing history and gets no later periodic retry.
Open due probes retain the existing 30-second cadence and concurrency cap of four.
Successful writer-owned final replacement invalidates the prior parsed-final cache even if old/new filesystem timestamps are equal; failed writes retain their reported outcome.
exclusions: Startup-terminal or abandoned keys are never eligible for a finishing attempt.
Manual exact-current observation stays available through its existing owner.
A real reopen invalidates old final facts; build-only reopened phases remain probe-free until landing becomes active again.

evidence: requirements/MIK-R40-v2-reviewer-read-latency-on-git-trees.md rule 8 landing probes; background worker exact owner; exact post-B1 source notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-worker-R2-evidence/final-2026-10-03/candidate-reader-post-b1.json sha256:ff7a5201d4ed37a6d2e109d9a8d3b9374adbd5f44009b7e7f686274ed218b6b2; independent R1/R2 plus notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-review-R3.md (SHA-256 c9a9ea931c18de68182a0f1f12d57cc7e72d29358ed463328ce3d11ca3c988fd); phase-specific performance evidence remains pending; notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-background-B1-worker.md; L40-R2-B1 cache replacement defect fixed, independently cleared by root R3.

statement: Historical completed/abandoned keys cause zero periodic Git/network probes, including after a process start.
